input.quote: 13.6 Independent Development: Covenant not to Sue. Nothing in this Agreement will be construed to prohibit either parties' right to independently develop the Developments contemplated above.
input.rationale: No non-compete or field-of-use restraint binds Corio's own business. The Grant of Rights (§§2.1–2.10) and §2.7 Restrictions only limit how Corio may use, copy and sublicense Commerce One's Software; the "Corio Market Segment" (§1.3) and "Territory" (§1.24) definitions likewise scope the licence grant rather than restrict what businesses Corio may operate or what products it may buy or build. §13.6 expressly preserves each party's right to develop independently, and §14.8 confirms Corio solely directs and may subcontract the Corio Services. The only competitor reference (§14.1) is a mutual assignment consent right, not a covenant not to compete, and the sales and marketing cooperation in Exhibit D is expressly "non-binding". This meets the preferred position (no non-compete on Customer), so no redline is warranted.
